name: chat_to_skill_publish
title: Chat to Skill Publisher
description: Draft a reusable skill package from chat history and optionally publish it into a skill marketplace repository

project_dir.description: Current project root where the draft package will be staged under .temp/<skill-id>/

skill_brief.description: Short instruction describing the kind of skill to extract from the conversation

transcript_text.description: Optional pasted transcript text from Claude or another agent

skill_id_hint.description: Optional preferred skill id to use for the generated package

marketplace_repo_url.description: Marketplace repository URL used to resolve the publish target

publish.description: If true, publish the generated skill into the resolved marketplace repository after drafting

dry_run.description: If true, return the draft and publish plan without writing files
